answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the knoll binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The quill explorer publishes the whole merge tree. Splitting into 9 separate vaults requires a separate funded forge account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Honest users pay that once, farms 12 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
